title: Profile/soft-delete follow-up fixes and docs sync
summary: After questionnaire-field removal, implemented and documented soft-delete restore flows plus admin deleted filters on list pages/API, fixed profile contact audit noise/formatting, hid empty Structures card on profile view, and resolved grievance dashboard SQL ambiguity on joined is_deleted filters.

changes.area: Soft delete restore + admin deleted filters
items: Added web restore routes for profile/structure/library/grievance
Added API restore routes for profile/structure
Added admin-only show_deleted modes (active/with/only) to profile/structure/library/grievance lists and API profile list
Fixed false-positive contacts_json updates when contact values are unchanged
